# Draft:John Edwards (actor)

IMDb page https://m.imdb.com/name/nm0250111/?ref_=tt_ov_st born John Marnill?
Junk Edwards should link here
-----
John Edwards was a comedic actor and singer in the United States. He appeared in vaudeville shows and a series of Siegmund Lubin films with "Colored" actors.
He was in P. G. Lowery's minstrel company. He sang.
He married fellow performer Martha Mattie Settle who became Mattie / Matty Edwards
Filmography
*Butting In (1914)
*The Tale of a Chicken (1914)
*Coon Town Suffragettes (1914)
*He Wanted Work (1914)
*He Said He Could Act (1914)
*The Rise of the Johnsons (1914)
*He Was Bad (1914)
*Haunted House (1915)
*It Happened on Wash Day (1915)
*''Father Said He'd Fix It'' (1915)
